speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's syndrome with secondary pulmonary hypertension and emphysematous changes.

Based on the confirmed hypercortisolism, your shortness of breath is likely driven by a combination of underlying emphysema and fluid retention increasing your blood volume, which strains your heart and lungs. While the cough is typical of the lung damage, the primary driver of your dyspnea is now the systemic effects of the excess cortisol on your cardiovascular system.
